report_identity.report_title: Shanghai Gench Education Group Limited Annual Report 2024

business_overview.one_sentence: The group principally provides higher education services in Mainland China through Shanghai Jian Qiao University and PRC affiliated entities controlled by contractual arrangements.
business_overview.revenue_model: Tuition fees and boarding fees are generally paid in advance before the academic year and recognised over the service period; small education related and other services are also provided.
business_notes: All revenue and long-term assets/capital expenditure were generated or located in the PRC.
New PRC Affiliated Entities contributed RMB944.443 million revenue, RMB171.225 million net profit and RMB3,624.675 million total assets in 2024.
Contract liabilities represent prepaid tuition and boarding fees for unsatisfied performance obligations, with students entitled to refunds for services not yet rendered.

profit_cash_conversion.assessment: Operating cash flow exceeded accounting profit over 2022-2024 because tuition and boarding fees are prepaid, but distributable cash is constrained by campus capital expenditure, secured bank borrowings, contract liabilities and PRC/VIE cash extraction limits.

gaps: The annual report does not split cash by listed-company parent, WFOE and PRC affiliated school entities; only parent-company cash of RMB8.820 million is separately visible in note 36.
The annual report does not provide a full maturity and product-risk schedule for each wealth management product.
Maintenance versus growth capital expenditure is not explicitly separated; the owner-earnback analysis uses a conservative cash-flow haircut rather than a precise maintenance capex schedule.
Only 2022 comparative figures were extracted from the 2023 annual report as work evidence; a separate 2022 fact pack was not created because stock_report_paths only point to the 2024 period.
